_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d3; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint G2 (first conversation, repeat line, post-memory line), K (resolution), B3/C (names, roles). 'questions' are NOT in the blueprint: A10 asks for evidence-gated investigation questions but none are written, so they were added (marked added: true; proofread). Each question appears once its 'requires' evidence is known.

mira.name: Mira
mira.role: Mira, 28 - schoolteacher. Nia was her pupil.
first: I remember a hand. Never the face above it.
mira.repeat: The rope was untouched. Look at the bell.
mira.postMemory: You found the hand I could not remember.

questions.answer: My ledger says 2:31 too. Clocks lie. Ink doesn't.

questions.ask: Arun saw a figure on the river path.
questions.answer: A coat. A staff. A hand on Nia's door.

questions.ask: Leela says the lantern records memories.
questions.answer: Then the bell was not ringing for us. It was listening.

questions.ask: Someone scraped a name from your register.
questions.answer: Elias. The lantern apprentice. Nia's brother.

questions.ask: Why did you say I came back?
questions.answer: Because you did. I can't see your face either.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot say who rang the bell, or whose hand took Nia.
resolution.scene: The investigator lays the bell card beside the lantern residue. Mira recognizes the machine's signature and lets her loop go.

arun.name: Arun
first: Someone carried a child toward the lantern-house.
arun.postMemory: The night kept moving after they stopped it.

questions.answer: Everyone heard it. Nobody pulled it.

questions.ask: Mira saw an apprentice lantern staff.
questions.answer: He crossed the riverbed with it. Coat like yours.

questions.ask: Leela's notes name a child: Nia Vane.
questions.answer: Nia. Silver clip. Her brother kept the lanterns.
Scratched deep. Yours is scratched in the same spot.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot reconcile the 2:31 watch with the 2:17 clocks or identify the child.
resolution.scene: The 2:31 watch and the hairclip are laid side by side. Arun accepts that the walker carried Nia after the clocks stopped.
resolution.lastLine: The night did not end at two-seventeen.

leela.name: Leela
leela.role: Leela, 56 - lantern-keeper and archivist. She taught the apprentice.
first: I kept records under the floor.
The lantern was never a toy.
If you find the master log, read all of it.
leela.postMemory: Some truths were buried because I helped bury them.

questions.ask: Mira saw the apprentice lantern staff.
questions.answer: Only one apprentice ever carried it.

questions.ask: Arun found a sluice beneath the workshop.
questions.answer: It cools the lantern. I sealed the channels after.

questions.ask: The clock tower carries lantern residue.
questions.answer: Then the network is still awake.

questions.ask: Thirty-two anchors. Why only three of you?
questions.answer: The rest are sleeping. We saw too much to sleep.
He walked out of Veyra. Nobody followed.

questions.ask: Your rules say a lantern lights for one hand.
questions.answer: Yes. I wondered who had lit yours.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot accept that she allowed the trials on Nia and failed to stop him.
resolution.scene: The master log is read aloud. Leela faces the record of the activation, her warning, and the trials she allowed.
